description: This file defines the FulfilledPromise class, which implements promise handling behavior for fulfilled promises within the GuzzleHttp promise library. It includes methods for chaining, waiting, resolving, and rejecting, adhering to the PromiseInterface.

classes.name: FulfilledPromise
classes.description: A class representing a promise that has already been fulfilled; implements PromiseInterface and provides methods for promise chaining and status checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a FulfilledPromise with a given value, ensuring it is not created with an object that has a 'then' method.

methods.name: then
methods.description: Registers callbacks to be executed when the promise is fulfilled or rejected, returning a new promise for chaining.

methods.name: otherwise
methods.description: Registers a callback to be executed if the promise is rejected, for handling errors.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Waits for the promise to settle and returns the value if unwrap is true.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state of the promise, which should be 'fulfilled'.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Ensures that the promise cannot be resolved to a different value if it is already fulfilled.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Throws an exception because a fulfilled promise cannot be rejected.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Method does nothing in fulfilled promise context.
